title: UX Copywriter
description:
Who we are:
 We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.
 We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.
   Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?
 About the role.
We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint.
 Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch.
 You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches.
 This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments.
 We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch.
 Day to day responsibilities.
 Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys.
 Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch.
 Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints…

title: Pharmacy Team Lead
description:
What is the job?
 Ready to take the next step in your leadership career and make a real impact within a rapidly growing, patient-focused organisation?
 We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Team Leader or Manager to join us as a Pharmacy Team Lead. This is an exciting opportunity to bring your leadership experience into a fast-paced healthcare environment, supporting, motivating and developing a high-performing team across both weekday and weekend shifts.
 You do not need previous pharmacy experience or a pharmacy qualification for this role. What we are looking for is someone with strong people leadership experience who knows how to run a successful shift, manage competing priorities, support their team and maintain high standards in a busy operational environment.
 As Pharmacy Team Lead, you will be right at the heart of our day-to-day pharmacy operations. This is a hands-on role where no two days will be the same. You will help coordinate shifts, manage changing priorities, resolve operational challenges and provide clear, confident guidance to colleagues.
 You will act as a visible and approachable point of leadership on shift, ensuring workloads are managed effectively, standards are consistently maintained and any issues are identified and addressed quickly. You will also support the development of your colleagues through regular feedback, coaching and encouragement, helping them build their confidence, strengthen their skills and take pride in the service they provide.
 Working closely with the Pharmacy Manager and wider Pharmacy Operations team, you will help drive continuous improvement across the pharmacy. Whether it’s finding better ways of working, improving efficiency, strengthening communication or supporting the implementation of new processes, you will have the opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine difference to how we operate.
 This role would be perfect for someone who thrives in a busy environment, enjoys bringing people…

title: Creator Success Representative
description:
Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $200M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.
 As Fanvue scales, we need to protect and grow revenue across our mid-to-long-tail creator base without relying on 1:1 CSM ratios. The Pooled CSM model is how we do that: one person owning a large book of creators through data-driven playbooks, automated workflows, and targeted interventions.
 🎯 The Role We're hiring a Pooled Creator Success Manager to own retention and revenue outcomes across a portfolio of 500+ creators in a 1:many, tech-touch model.
 This is not a traditional CSM seat. You will not have a handful of named accounts and weekly check-ins. Instead, you will build and run scalable playbooks, monitor risk and contraction signals across a large cohort, and intervene where the data tells you to. Think CS operations meets account management.
 You will report to Thea and work closely with the wider Creator Success team.
 🚀 What You'll Do Own a pooled book of 500+ creators with full accountability for gross revenue retention
 Build, maintain, and iterate playbooks that drive retention, reduce contraction, and surface expansion opportunities at scale
 Monitor creator health signals (engagement drops, earnings decline, support ticket spikes) and run targeted interventions before churn materialises
 Run a weekly cadence: risk alerts, contraction monitoring, playbook execution reviews
 Design and automate lifecycle touchpoints (onboarding sequences, re-engagement campaigns, feature adoption nudges) through CS platform workflows
 Support the broader CS team by providing pooled coverage as more creators move out of dedicated 1:1 management

title: Content & Digital Sponsorship Executive.
description:
The Company
 When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
 We connect industry leaders and innovators through unparalleled networking opportunities. We bring together leading minds to share the latest trends, challenges and opportunities facing companies, the tactics and tools needed to drive results, and a forum to make meaningful connections.
 Our Alliance brand is renowned for its VIP dinners, exclusive breakfasts, and bespoke 1-2-1 meeting packages designed to bridge supply and demand across various verticals. Join our dynamic team and drive sales to new commercial prospects, creating valuable connections and driving business growth.
 The Role
 As a Digital & Advertising Sponsorship Executive, you’ll play a key role in connecting leading B2B brands with our highly engaged professional communities through impactful digital B2B demand generation, data, media services, online display advertising and influencer campaigns
 From webinars and custom content, to virtual roundtables and lead generation programs, you’ll craft solutions that deliver genuine value and measurable ROI. This is a hands-on, commercially focused role for someone who thrives on building client relationships, solving problems creatively, and driving revenue.
 You'll join a fast-paced, supportive team with strong growth potential. This is a hands-on commercial role perfect for someone eager to accelerate their career in digital media sales, advertising partnerships, and influencer marketing.
 Key Responsibilities:
 Drive Digital Growth: Own and grow your pipeline across digital sponsorship and advertising channels (including website placements, newsletter sponsorships, influencer programs & campaigns, and lead-gen content like webinars and white papers). Prospect, pitch, and close deals across both net-new and existing accounts…

title: B2CP Growth Analyst
description:
📍Location - this role is based in our London office 2 days per week with the remaining 3 days working remotely
 Business to Consumer Partnerships is arguably the most entrepreneurial team at Goodlord. This role exists because there's a clear prize on the table: improving broadband and media lead conversion, launching a dedicated propositions for the tenants groups who are currently under-served, and bringing rigour and ownership to our smaller partnerships.
 You'll get real ownership fast, commercial relationships, live dashboards and forecasting models from day one, with a clear trajectory towards owning a full product vertical of your own as the team grows.
 Our mission:
 Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. Goodlord's mission? To be the gold standard platform for renting 🌎
 We started Goodlord because we wanted to make renting simple and transparent for everyone involved: the agent, the landlord, and the tenant. We knew Generation Rent would lead to more tenants, with higher digital expectations and we were confident we could provide a solution 🏠
 Like all scale-ups it’s been a bit of a rollercoaster journey, but we’re now stronger than ever, with around 3,000 letting agents using the platform, exciting and varied products and 350+ Goodlordians across the group supporting the mission! 💚
 The Opportunity:
 Drive improvement projects that lift partner conversion: spanning data enrichment, leads management, product suitability, and marketing/communications across the tenant journey
 Own the flow of performance data back from partners, build and maintain the dashboards that give the team real-time visibility, and run partner performance meetings that drive actions to a clear conclusion
